I01.why: Successive percent increase then decrease of a price, compared via the product of multipliers; idea adds the order comparison (commutativity) and asks which is higher instead of the final percent.
Equal percent increase then decrease giving a net loss (1+p)(1-p)<1; ACT item solves for p from the net change, idea compares two orders at p=10%.

I04.why: Unknown marble count recovered from a given probability; SAT item uses a single draw (linear), idea uses two draws without replacement (quadratic).
Demo fixture computes P(both same color) for two draws without replacement from a marble bag; idea runs the same model in reverse (given P, find count).

I11.why: Right triangle with legs in a fixed ratio linked by Pythagoras to area/hypotenuse; SAT item gives area and asks hypotenuse, idea gives hypotenuse and asks area.
Legs expressed in one variable plus given hypotenuse, asked for area; SAT item uses an additive relation (x, x+7) needing a quadratic, idea uses a ratio.

I15.why: Same rational-equation template: x/(x-2) on one side, constant/(x-2) plus a constant term, clear the common denominator x-2 and check for the excluded value; only numbers (and whether the root is extraneous) change.

I16.why: Solving an exponential equation by rewriting as a power of 2 (2^x = 8); SAT item adds a coefficient and shifted exponent.

I18.why: Same template: exponential model with exponent t/k, given a target value whose ratio to the initial value is an exact power of the base, solve for t (50*2^(t/3)=400 vs 18000*0.75^(t/2)=10125); idea differs only by decay vs growth.
Exponential model with exponent t/5 solved for t at a target value, but ACT item needs logarithms (non-integer power).

I22.why: Pending draft: unknown slope of a line found from a condition on its intersection with a given line (x-coordinate = 2); idea uses the condition x = y on the line through the origin.

I31.why: Each data value multiplied by a constant; asked for the new standard deviation (scales by the factor). ACT item adds a shift and also asks the mean, but the idea's whole question is contained in it.

I32.why: 90-degree rotation of a point about the origin; ACT item rotates clockwise and then reflects, idea is a single counterclockwise rotation.
90-degree counterclockwise rotation of a point; ACT item rotates about (1, 1) rather than the origin.

I35.why: Greatest number of complete recipe batches from a supply (floor of a quotient); ACT item adds a second limiting ingredient, idea divides by a fraction.
